channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-mac
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: ordino — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that arranges every window on the display with one keystroke, with layouts that adapt to the window count and screen shape.

item.title: WindowShade — via awesome-mac
item.description: Double-click a title bar and the window rolls up into a thin bar where it was; also pinned previews and Picture in Picture.

item.title: WinPlug — via awesome-mac
item.description: Windows-style taskbar with window previews, Alt-Tab between windows, snipping tool and Ctrl shortcuts in one app for people switching from Windows.

item.title: Umbra — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native macOS code editor with a built-in coding agent and integrated debugging.

item.title: Seawall — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar app that locks distracting sites and apps until a set time, with a wait if you leave early.

item.title: Rakazo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app for running self-hosted AI agents with their own computers, memory, and scheduled tasks.

item.title: Pagekin (AI Novel Writer) — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source AI writing workspace for organizing characters, worldbuilding, outlines, chapters, review, and revision in one novel project.

item.title: IPA-Decrypt — via awesome-mac
item.description: Graphical App Store and TestFlight IPA downloader and FairPlay decryptor for macOS and iOS, with credential management.

item.title: Earth Now — via awesome-mac
item.description: Live 3D Earth as your desktop wallpaper, with the real sun position, city lights and satellite clouds.

item.title: DropExe — via awesome-mac
item.description: Run Windows games and apps on Apple Silicon through Wine, with one-click Steam and Epic installs, drag-and-drop for any .exe, and a Make it run button that tries graphics settings (DXMT, DXVK, D3DMetal) until a game starts.

item.title: Coinsole — via awesome-mac
item.description: Turns your Mac into a game console: add your own web games or Mac apps and play with an Xbox or PlayStation controller.

item.title: CoPanda — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source clipboard manager with a searchable local history, no account and no telemetry.

item.title: holzBar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar manager, a fork of Ice, that hides menu bar icons and adds profiles, widgets, system readouts and a notch hub.

item.title: VirtualBuddy — via awesome-mac
item.description: Run macOS and ARM Linux virtual machines on Apple silicon Macs.

item.title: Squeeze7z — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source tool that repacks folders and archives into smaller 7z files, choosing the method for each file type and verifying every file before keeping the result.

item.title: OhMyShot — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native menu bar tool for screenshots, scrolling capture, annotation, pinning, screen recording with Studio auto-zoom, and on-device OCR.

item.title: Nook — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source notch app with Now Playing for any player including browsers, a volume and brightness HUD, a focus timer, Reminders, tasks, Markdown notes and a file shelf.

item.title: Friday — via awesome-mac
item.description: Free, open-source app that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other coding agents as one team, with a shared task board, a git worktree per agent, diff review with line notes, and a hand-off when one hits its usage limit.

item.title: FestiveLights — via awesome-mac
item.description: Christmas lights under the menu bar and on the Dock, with snow that settles on your windows.

item.title: Earpiece — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar call copilot that transcribes on-device, spots questions aimed at you and shows a suggested answer in the notch while the call is live, using your Claude subscription.

item.title: BotArk — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source (MIT) native desktop workspace unifying Grok Bot, Google Antigravity, ChatGPT Dot, Meta Muse, Hark, Cue, and Hermes with multi-agent collaboration rooms, per-account proxy isolation, and approval-gated local MCP.

item.title: AI Hub Bar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar app that shows the usage limits of Claude, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI and Cursor, lists every running agent session, and answers their permission requests from a notification.

item.title: Tidywise — via awesome-mac
item.description: Local-first menu bar app that sorts loose Mac files into Markdown-indexed topic folders with Ollama, with full undo and a read-only MCP server for AI assistants.

item.title: Relaycat — via awesome-mac
item.description: Runs several Claude desktop accounts, switches between them in one click, brings chats along and shows each account's session and weekly limits.

item.title: Meboki — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source grammar checker that runs a local model on your Mac and fixes text in any app.

item.title: AutoWindow — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar app that restores window layouts per monitor setup and per Mission Control desktop.

item.title: AppuBot — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source (Apache 2.0) team of AI bots, each with its own job, that hand tasks to each other and work in your real apps and files, on the Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok or Copilot plan you already have.

item.title: Alook — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source, local-first group chat where people and coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex work together in shared rooms.

item.title: VYSHYVKA BAR — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source Touch Bar replacement with animated Ukrainian embroidery, weather forecast, and system controls.

item.title: SpecWithCode — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source (MIT) desktop app that runs Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot threads side by side, with a project coordinator and one git worktree per task.

item.title: Roomie — via awesome-mac
item.description: A pair of cartoon eyes that lives in the menu bar, reacts to what you do, and pops out of the notch to remind you to rest your eyes, take a walk and go to bed.

item.title: Nuclear — via awesome-mac
item.description: Streaming music player that finds free music for you.

item.title: CutVoke — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source, local-first video editor with a built-in MCP server, so AI agents and you edit the same multi-track timeline.

item.title: CurlGo — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source API client for HTTP, SSE and WebSocket that keeps workspaces on your Mac and imports curl, Postman and Bruno collections.

item.title: Cue — via awesome-mac
item.description: Desktop AI assistant for voice typing, meeting transcription, and supported agent tasks using context you provide.

item.title: CablePeek — via awesome-mac
item.description: Shows the USB-C link speed at the screen edge next to the port when you plug in, with eject on hover.

item.title: Verticar — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source app for using an iPad as a portrait second display over Sidecar.

item.title: Vaquero — via awesome-mac
item.description: Learns a face from a few photos, then finds every photo and video of that person in your folders, fully offline.

item.title: TurboControl — via awesome-mac
item.description: Lightweight menu bar utility for Intel Macs: 1-click Intel Turbo Boost toggle, fan speed control, and live CPU/GPU thermal monitoring.

item.title: Tally — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source menu bar app that shows usage limits, reset times, pace and spend for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok and OpenCode, plus a Wrapped-style recap of your AI coding.

item.title: SpatialAudio — via awesome-mac
item.description: System-wide Apple HRTFHQ spatial soundstage and speaker virtualization for any headphones in the menu bar.

item.title: Relay — via awesome-mac
item.description: Switch the Claude app between accounts, keep Claude Code history on all of them, and see every account’s 5-hour and weekly limits.

item.title: PowerLock — via awesome-mac
item.description: Keeps your Mac unlocked and awake with the lid closed while on AC power, and restores normal sleep on battery.

item.title: Out to Sea — via awesome-mac
item.description: Menu bar break reminders: a live-rendered sea fills the screen when it is time to look into the distance, then guides a minute of slow breathing.

item.title: MySpotify — via awesome-mac
item.description: Unofficial lightweight native Spotify desktop client built in Go (MyGo), with floating desktop lyrics, synced lyrics fallback, music videos, video podcasts, and notch player.

item.title: MenuBarHome — via awesome-mac
item.description: Control Xiaomi Mi Home and Home Assistant devices from the menu bar, with keyboard search and voice commands (formerly MenuBarMijia).

item.title: Lokii — via awesome-mac
item.description: Ultra-fast, lightweight native macOS instant file search tool like Everything for Mac.

item.title: Kapitsa — via awesome-mac
item.description: Open-source LLM inference engine for Apple silicon, built on native Metal kernels and the Neural Engine, with OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs and one-command local coding agents.

item.title: Hop — via awesome-mac
item.description: Tiny menu-bar launcher for remote Macs, Tailscale discovery, Screen Sharing, and SSH.

item.title: ContextRing — via awesome-mac
item.description: Native macOS floating context ring and menu bar token monitor for Google Antigravity 2.0, with local context breakdown and 24h/7d stats.
